title: InternalTerraformingStateSpec
description: Operational constraints and state validation schema for Planetary Homeostasis and Internal Terraforming based on OPSTACK-KERNEL-v2.1 physicalist invariants.

landauer_bound.description: Validation of local compute power efficiency versus central datacenter power dissipation (OPSTACK-KERNEL-v2.1 Invariant 2).

central_cluster_power_watts.description: Classical central datacenter power consumption in Watts.

landauer_efficiency_ratio.description: Ratio of thermodynamic work output to minimum Landauer heat dissipation limit.

ashby_parity.description: Requisite variety mapping between local exocortex, operator, and biospheric environmental perturbations (OPSTACK-KERNEL-v2.1 Invariant 1).

variety_local_exocortex.description: Logarithmic count of distinct controllable micro-states in local silicon exocortex.

variety_biological_operator.description: Logarithmic count of distinct biological operator states.

variety_environment.description: Logarithmic count of environmental perturbation states.

ashby_parity_satisfied.description: Evaluates True iff Variety(Exocortex) >= Variety(Operator) >= Variety(Environment).

steady_state_metrics.description: Biospheric non-equilibrium steady state thermodynamic metrics.

biosphere_heat_dissipation_watts_per_m2.description: Mean thermal radiation flux across planetary surface boundary.

entropy_delta_joules_per_kelvin.description: Net entropy change rate of the local biospheric state space (Delta S <= 0 for steady-state homeostasis).

carbon_loop_stability_index.description: Normalized stability coefficient of closed-loop biospheric carbon and nutrient cycling.

expansion_gate.description: State engine execution lock governing off-planet signal and matter egress.

planetary_homeostasis_achieved.description: System state flag indicating verified biospheric homeostasis.

off_planet_expansion_allowed.description: Hard Boolean state engine lock; evaluated strictly as false if planetary_homeostasis_achieved is false.
